title: 第9章 天灵炼丹术第10章 诡异
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“夫人、金小姐，阿兰怎么样了？”
石泉水本来在和阿兰聊天，一个筑基修士偷袭，一剑刺穿阿兰胸膛，并用暗器击中了他。
也幸好穿着机甲，不然暗器上剧毒足够毒死他几十次了。
可惜，在毫无战斗力的情况下，让对方轻松逃走了。
“多谢关心，阿兰用了先生的药，目前已无大碍，休养一二日便可痊愈。”
霓羽盈盈一礼表示对他的感谢。
阿兰送回去时，其实已无大碍，不过霓羽还是让医师仔细一番。
这才发现所中的毒竟是邪道黑死血崖独有的毒药——名万藿紫心毒。
此毒乃用多种毒草、毒虫炼化而成。
此毒药连圣药王宗的都没办法调配出解药。
而石泉水却只用奇怪的药贴，就解毒了。
霓羽一路上满脑子都是这药贴，此时正想询问，却被她娘打断了思路。
“先生，请坐。”
三夫人见是个瘦弱老人，不免有些失望，来时也听霓羽说了样貌，当时还以为是那位大修假扮。
此时见了却发现一丝灵力波动，很难让人相信那药贴是出自他手。
碍于情面，她没有流露出一丝轻蔑。
石泉水谢了一番，等到夫人和那金小姐坐下，这才扯开凳子坐下。
“夫人，此事有些古怪。”
三夫人一边听一边从袖内抽出丝帕擦拭了一下额头。
“先生，此事或与羽儿有关。”

“夫人是否暗指金小姐走火入魔之事。”
在车厢里，石泉水大致了解当年和近年的一些事情，对霓羽的遭遇也深表同情。
“此事尚需谨慎，还请先生勿要对他人说起。”
三夫人知道他没有真凭实据，为了家族名声，还是要关照一番。
霓羽起身拿起茶壶给娘倒了一杯，然后端着茶壶走到石泉水身边，也想倒一杯。
石泉水自知无福消受，赶紧婉拒了，毕竟也没做什么。
金霓羽却觉得必须，倒了一杯茶，双膝跪地，高举茶杯，“请先生用茶。”
这可把石泉水吓坏了，赶紧起身将她扶起，“小姐使不得，我乃一乡野小民，受不得此里，再说......”
“先生，怎么了？”
金霓羽看他的目光转向她娘，心里莫名地咯噔了一下。
“夫人，出发时可吃了或喝了什么，怎么有中毒迹象。”
石泉水嘴上如此明理，心里却是连连叫苦。
好不容易赊了创口贴，结果都给人了。
如今看到这这两人，自知她们肯定会询问那创口贴的事情，无论怎么样，那个夫人肯定不会相信。
三夫人一听，当即面色一紧，她暗自运气，发现并无太大问题。
content_en:
"Madam, Miss Jin, how is Alan?"
Shi Quanshui was chatting with Alan when a foundation-building monk made a sneak attack, pierced Alan's chest with a sword, and hit him with a hidden weapon.
Fortunately, he was wearing a mecha, otherwise the poison in the hidden weapon would have been enough to kill him dozens of times.
It's a pity that the other party escaped easily without any fighting power.
"Thank you for your concern. Alan took sir's medicine and is now fine. He will recover in a day or two."
Ni Yu bowed to express her gratitude to him.
When Alan was sent back, he was actually fine, but Niyu still asked the doctor to take a closer look.
Only then did he discover that the poison he was poisoned was actually a poison unique to the evil Black Death Blood Cliff - named Wanhuo Purple Heart Poison.
This poison is refined from a variety of poisonous weeds and poisonous insects.
Even the Holy Medicine King Sect couldn't prepare an antidote for this poison.
However, Shiquan Shui only used a strange medicinal patch to detoxify it.
Niyu's mind was full of this medicinal patch along the way. She was about to ask, but her mother interrupted her train of thought.
"Sir, please sit down."
The third lady couldn't help but be a little disappointed when she saw that he was a thin old man. When she came, she also heard Ni Yu's description of his appearance. At that time, she thought it was the overhaul pretending to be.
At this time, when he saw it, he found a slight fluctuation in spiritual power. It was difficult for people to believe that the medicinal patch was made by him.
Out of sympathy, she didn't show a trace of contempt.
Shi Quanshui thanked her and waited until Madam and Miss Jin sat down before pulling up the stool and sitting down.
"Ma'am, this is a bit strange."
While listening, the third lady took out a silk handkerchief from her sleeve and wiped her forehead.
"Sir, this matter may be related to Yu'er."
"Is Madam alluding to Miss Jin's obsession?"
In the carriage, Shi Quanshui roughly understood some of the events of that year and recent years, and expressed deep sympathy for Ni Yu's experience.
"This matter requires caution, sir, please don't mention it to others."
The third lady knew that he had no real evidence, so she still had to take care of him for the sake of the family's reputation.
Niyu stood up and picked up the teapot and poured a cup for her mother. Then she walked to Shiquanshui with the teapot and wanted to pour a cup too.
Shi Quanshui knew that he was not happy to accept it, so he quickly declined it. After all, he didn't do anything.
Jin Niyu felt it was necessary, so he poured a cup of tea, knelt on his knees, raised the cup high, and said, "Sir, please have some tea."
This frightened Shi Quanshui, and he quickly stood up and helped her up, "Miss, you can't help me. I'm a countryman and I can't bear to be here. Besides..."
"Sir, what's wrong?"
Jin Niyu's heart skipped a beat when she saw his eyes turning to her mother.
"Madam, what did you eat or drink when you set off? Why are there signs of poisoning?"
Shi Quanshui spoke so clearly, but in his heart he kept complaining.
I finally got band-aids on credit, but ended up giving them away.
Now that I see these two people, I know that they will definitely ask about the band-aid. No matter what, the lady will definitely not believe it.
When the third lady heard this, her expression immediately tightened. She secretly felt lucky and found that there was no big problem.
